## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 26 ago 2026 - 27 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Zani Fourie_, 27 ago 2026, 1/5: "Basically just a calorie counting app, and I can't see how much I logged yesterday. The private coaching is very expensive compared to the app price it's not included. Every time you cancel or go back from an offer they offer it to you at an even cheaper price so they catch you with the bigger price if you don't know this and select and pay for it which I think is quite shameful."
            2. _Kara Kugler_, 26 ago 2026, 1/5: "their app is horrible always crushing, taking up too much of time when it is supposed to help. I'm going to cancel my subscription because of the app"
            3. _Sarah ST_, 26 ago 2026, 2/5: "As great as it is I can't use it it keeps crashing cancelled my subscription"
<!--/ir-theme-->
